events.title: BigCommerce launched
events.summary: Eddie Machaalani and Mitchell Harper launched BigCommerce in August 2009 — a hosted e-commerce SaaS platform evolved from their Interspire shopping cart.
events.about: BigCommerce gave SMB merchants enterprise features — multi-channel selling, SEO tools, and themes — without server management. It competed with Shopify and Magento for mid-market stores and later went public on NASDAQ in 2020.

narrative.whyChosen: BigCommerce became a major hosted alternative to Shopify for growing online retailers.
narrative.whyImportant: It proved SaaS e-commerce could scale from Sydney startup to public company.
narrative.problemSolved: Merchants outgrew self-hosted carts but could not afford enterprise licensing or ops overhead.

sources.title: PR Newswire — BigCommerce hosted ecommerce since August 2009 (March 8, 2010)
